Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the familial hierarchy by promoting one generation up. After correctly noting that Nakkhatra Mangala was the son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana (which makes Voralaksana Busba’s paternal grandfather), the Planner wrongly concluded the grandfather was King Chulalongkorn (Rama V), who is actually her paternal great-grandfather. This contradicted earlier correct synthesis and led to the incorrect final answer.
